create_tensorboard_logger_hook: create a TensorboardLoggerHook instance to log training metrics to Tensorboard with custom log directory
configure_logging_interval: configure the TensorboardLoggerHook interval to log metrics every N iterations during training
log_scalars_and_text: log scalar values and text tags to Tensorboard using the hook's log method during runner execution
initialize_summary_writer: initialize a Tensorboard SummaryWriter in before_run to start logging to the specified log directory
close_tensorboard_writer: close the Tensorboard SummaryWriter in after_run to flush and finalize all logged metrics
